children: AMC announced a $2,000 million first-lien notes offering and simultaneous new term loan facilities to refinance existing debt and fund tender/redemptions.
Commenced private offering of $2,000M first-lien notes due 2031 to raise proceeds for refinancing and redemptions.
Launched syndication of a $850M first-lien term loan and entered commitment for a $1,120M second-lien term loan (11.25% fixed rate).
Proceeds plus cash to fund tender offer for 7.500% Senior Secured Notes due 2029 and redeem remaining notes by ~Feb 15, 2027.
Plans to redeem Muvico’s $903.4M 1.5L notes conditionally, subject to closing aggregate gross proceeds of at least $3,970M.
Furnished preliminary two-month results: consolidated revenue $1,334.8M (up 42.2%), attendance 58.2M (up 35.9%); cash $832.5M.
